name: petrified dragon
lore_descriptor: dragon bone turned to dark stone over ages nobody counted
first_pickup_chronicle: Put on petrified dragon bone, older than the gods. The ones who worked it did not survive the job. Every dragon nearby will know I am wearing its grandmother.
design_notes: Fills pf 88 gap. Premium tier, fire resistance, anti-dragon. Highest damage_mult (1.5) outside void_touched.
